preflight.hypothesis: Exact candidate support and explicit operator object attribution are lost by extrema-only registration. Test signature collisions without proposing classification.
preflight.falsification: Do not infer object support from scalar band, connected component or absence of reference. No truth or matcher changes.
preflight.scope: Two already captured setup frames, unchanged preprocessing/signature/matcher, synthetic support replacements; no video or detector rerun.

readout.conclusion: Scalar/bounding support is a many-to-one projection. Snapshot, support attribution and visibility must be distinguished; no optical/fluid decision is established.

runner.source:
"""Audit retained registration information, with unchanged production operators."""
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import asdict, replace
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys
root=Path.cwd();out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'src'))
os.environ['MPLCONFIGDIR']=str(out/'.mpl');os.environ['XDG_CACHE_HOME']=str(out/'.cache')
import cv2
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from oil_tracker.domain.detection import BoundaryCandidate
from oil_tracker.domain.enums import BoundaryKind
from oil_tracker.domain.recipe import InspectionRecipe
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.geometry_masks import build_mask_bundle
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.preprocessing import preprocess
from oil_tracker.adapters.vision.artifact_calibration import attach_spatial_signature,template_from_candidate,artifact_match_score
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(n,v):
 p=out/n;assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
pre=json.loads((out/'preflight.json').read_text());assert sha(Path(__file__))==pre['runner_sha256']
for n,h in pre['input_pins'].items():assert sha(root/n)==h,n
prior=root/'sample/output/s11-d2-recipe-artifact-20261008-001';a1=root/'sample/output/s11-a1-lineage-20261007-001/frames-final'
results=[];displays=[];counts=[]
for f,idx,folder in [(1260,5,prior),(1320,21,prior/'setup-f1320')]:
 data=json.loads((folder/'proposals.json').read_text());recipe=InspectionRecipe.from_dict(data['recipe']);glass=recipe.glasses[0]
 full=cv2.imread(str(folder/f'f{f}-full.png'));bundle=build_mask_bundle(full,glass);raster=preprocess(bundle.crop,bundle.effective_mask,glass.detector_settings)
 assert np.array_equal(bundle.crop,cv2.imread(str(folder/f'f{f}-original.png')))
 assert np.array_equal(raster.canny,cv2.imread(str(a1/f'f{f}-canny.png'),0))
 ox,oy=bundle.crop_origin;assert (ox,oy)==(543,798)
 matched=0
 for c in data['detection']['candidates']:
  if c['kind']!='oil_air':continue
  candidate=BoundaryCandidate(**dict(c,kind=BoundaryKind(c['kind'])))
  new=attach_spatial_signature(candidate,raster.horizontal_mask,glass,crop_origin=(ox,oy))
  fields=[k for k in c['features'] if k.startswith('artifact_')]
  assert fields and all(new.features[k]==c['features'][k] for k in fields)
  matched+=1
 counts.append({'frame':f,'oil_signatures_reproduced':matched})
 c=data['detection']['candidates'][idx];candidate=BoundaryCandidate(**dict(c,kind=BoundaryKind(c['kind'])))
 assert c['y']==(844 if f==1260 else 822)
 local=int(round(c['y']-oy));band=np.zeros(raster.canny.shape,bool);band[local-2:local+3]=True
 horizontal=(raster.horizontal_mask>0)&band;edges=(raster.canny>0)&band
 cols=np.flatnonzero(horizontal.any(axis=0));x0,x1=int(cols[0]),int(cols[-1]+1)
 template=template_from_candidate(candidate,name='diagnostic only');assert template is not None
 # Same extrema and the same candidate scalar, but only two endpoint pixels.
 sparse=np.zeros_like(raster.horizontal_mask);sparse[local,x0]=255;sparse[local,x1-1]=255
 sparse_candidate=attach_spatial_signature(candidate,sparse,glass,crop_origin=(ox,oy))
 assert all(sparse_candidate.features[k]==candidate.features[k] for k in fields)
 assert artifact_match_score(candidate,template)==artifact_match_score(sparse_candidate,template)==1.0
 # A support whose pixels are disjoint in Y also collapses to the same signature.
 shifted=np.zeros_like(sparse);shifted[local-2,x0:x1]=255
 shifted_candidate=attach_spatial_signature(candidate,shifted,glass,crop_origin=(ox,oy))
 assert all(shifted_candidate.features[k]==candidate.features[k] for k in fields)
 assert artifact_match_score(shifted_candidate,template)==1.0
 row={'frame':f,'candidate_input_index':idx,'source':c['source'],'canonical_y':c['y'],
      'source_x_extent':[x0+ox,x1+ox],'signature_band_source_y':[local-2+oy,local+3+oy],
      'horizontal_mask_pixels':int(horizontal.sum()),'raw_canny_pixels':int(edges.sum()),
      'morphology_added_pixels':int((horizontal&~edges).sum()),
      'sparse_support_pixels':int((sparse>0).sum()),'disjoint_shifted_support_pixels':int((shifted>0).sum()),
      'same_signature_for_all_three':True,'match_scores':[1.,1.,1.],
      'physical_decision':'NOT_EVALUATED','template_fields':sorted(asdict(template))}
 if f==1260:
  box=np.zeros_like(band);box[839-oy:848-oy,581-ox:605-ox]=True
  n,labels=cv2.connectedComponents((raster.canny>0).astype('uint8'),connectivity=8)
  ids=sorted(int(i) for i in np.unique(labels[box]) if i)
  components=[]
  for i in ids:
   m=labels==i;ys,xs=np.where(m)
   components.append({'id':i,'pixels_inside_display_box':int((m&box).sum()),'pixels_outside_display_box':int((m&~box).sum()),
                      'source_bbox_xyxy':[int(xs.min())+ox,int(ys.min())+oy,int(xs.max()+1)+ox,int(ys.max()+1)+oy]})
  row['human_feature_context']={'source_box_xyxy':[581,839,605,848],'pixel_truth':'NOT_ASSIGNED','canny_components_touching_box':components,
      'horizontal_band_pixels_inside_box':int((horizontal&box).sum()),'horizontal_band_pixels_outside_box':int((horizontal&~box).sum())}
 results.append(row);displays.append((f,c,bundle.crop,raster.canny,horizontal,edges,sparse,shifted))
save('readout.json',{'source_head':pre['source_head'],'signature_reproduction':counts,'controls':results,
 'conclusion':'Scalar/bounding support is a many-to-one projection. Snapshot, support attribution and visibility must be distinguished; no optical/fluid decision is established.'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,3,figsize=(12,8),layout='constrained')
for axis,(f,c,crop,canny,horizontal,edges,sparse,shifted) in zip(axes,displays,strict=True):
 for ax in axis:
  ax.imshow(cv2.cvtColor(crop,cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB),extent=(542.5,646.5,901.5,797.5),interpolation='nearest')
  ax.set_xlim(548,642);ax.set_ylim(890,802);ax.set_xlabel('source X');ax.set_ylabel('source Y')
 axis[0].set_title(f'{f/30:g} s: original and stored scalar')
 axis[0].axhline(c['y'],color='#df40d0',lw=1)
 axis[1].set_title('Pixels contributing to stored width')
 yy,xx=np.where(horizontal);axis[1].scatter(xx+543,yy+798,s=4,color='#27c4ed')
 yy,xx=np.where(edges);axis[1].scatter(xx+543,yy+798,s=4,color='#ff9600')
 axis[2].set_title('Two endpoints give the SAME signature')
 yy,xx=np.where(sparse);axis[2].scatter(xx+543,yy+798,s=35,color='#df40d0')
 if f==1260:
  from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
  for ax in axis:ax.add_patch(Rectangle((581,839),24,9,fill=False,color='#eeeeee',ls='--',lw=.8))
fig.suptitle('Registration geometry loses pixel identity and connectivity',fontsize=15)
fig.supxlabel('Cyan: horizontal mask after existing closing. Orange: raw Canny in the same band.\nRight panel is a synthetic information-loss control, not a new label or suggested detector. White box: prior human-review context only.',fontsize=9)
fig.savefig(out/'support-information-review.png',dpi=140);plt.close(fig)
for n,h in pre['input_pins'].items():assert sha(root/n)==h,n
save('receipt.json',{'status':'COMPLETE','preflight_sha256':sha(out/'preflight.json'),'input_preserved':True,'source_head':pre['source_head'],
 'video_read':False,'frame_detector_rerun':False,'preprocessing_reconstructed':True,'new_human_review':False,'recipe_changed':False,'auto_acceptance':False,
 'outputs':{n:sha(out/n) for n in ('readout.json','support-information-review.png')}})
print(json.dumps({'reproduction':counts,'controls':results},indent=2))

interpretation: Reference preservation and operator-attributed support are proposed; no complete physical classifier or detection change is established.
